description: Delivers the core rules and the record template when a session starts, and writes the effort level into work-item records.

hooks.command:
cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/rules/core.md" && printf '
Kit directory: %s

The record template, templates/record.md in the kit directory:

' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/templates/record.md"
